title: Emrys and the Autopsy
author: Xanthe Okafor
blurb: Elodie Sterling, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
